'''AgriSuub''' was a subsidiary of the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] that produced crops that would later be used to colonize new [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. AgriSuub operated a [[AgriSuub research facility|research facility]] in [[G'rinn Go city]] on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
